gate.name: k8
gate.description: Classify the type of task in a Kubernetes pull request by its primary intent

classes.label: bug
classes.description: Fixing crashes, panics, leaks, races, or incorrect behavior in Kubernetes components
utterances: fix kubelet crash loop when node runs out of ephemeral storage
fix API server panic triggered by CRD schema validation
patch memory leak in the kube-proxy IPVS load balancer path
repair off-by-one error in the scheduler pod affinity scoring
fix race condition between the controller-manager and garbage collector
fix broken TLS certificate reload in the aggregated API server
correct nil pointer dereference in the endpoint slice controller
address etcd client timeout during high-frequency lease renewals

classes.label: feature
classes.description: Introducing new capabilities, API resources, flags, or enhancements to Kubernetes
utterances: add support for topology spread constraints in the pod scheduler
imeplement dynamic client-side rate limiting for kube-apiserver requests
introduce pod disruption budget enforcement for voluntary node drains
extend kubectl with a new diff command for comparing live and declared state
add service internal traffic policy to restrict routing to node-local endpoints
create a new admission webhook framework for validating custom resources
add structured logging support to kubelet with configurable verbosity levels
introduce horizontal pod autoscaling based on custom metrics from external sources

classes.label: documentation
classes.description: Improving docs, API references, comments, guides, or the Kubernetes website
utterances: update the kubelet configuration reference README with the new eviction flags
document the CSI volume snapshot API with usage examples and caveats
add inline code comments for the scheduler preemption scoring logic
update stale cross-references description in the Kubernetes API reference pages
clarify the pod security admission policy format in the setup guide
update kubectl command reference with the newly added subcommand flags
add a guide for CoreDNS resolution in dual-stack clusters
rewrite the RBAC authorization overview to include aggregated ClusterRoles

classes.label: dependency
classes.description: Updating Go modules, vendor trees, or external library versions
utterances: bump the golang toolchain version from 1.22 to 1.23 in go.mod
upgrade the kubernetes client-go dependency to the v0.32.0 release
drop the deprecated k8s.io/utils/ptr package from the code-generator
pin the etcd client library to a stable commit hash for reproducibility
upgrade the OpenTelemetry SDK from v1.28 to v1.30 across all staging repos
vendor the regenerated protobuf definitions after the proto file sync
replace the archived golang.org/x/exp package with the new slices module
run go mod tidy across all staging repositories to prune unused imports
